title: juniperus phoenicea var. lycia
intro: Juniperus phoenicea var. lycia, commonly known as Lycia juniper, is a plant species within the cypress family (Cupressaceae), native to Turkey and Greece. This plant is valued for its traditional use in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lycia juniper include its antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as terpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Lycia juniper, including alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and myrcene, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
